title: Guilty by Suspicion
description: During the 1950s anti-Communist witch-hunts, a film director's career and personal life begin crumbling after he is accused of communist ties and blacklisted.

title: Strange Brew
description: The Canadian McKenzie brothers (Dave Thomas, Rick Moranis) cork a beer-factory brewmeister (Max von Sydow) who's out to rule the world.

title: Who's That Girl?
description: A hapless New Yorker's (Griffin Dunne) rich future father-in-law orders him to escort a bleached blonde (Madonna) out of town.

title: Funny Farm
description: A sportswriter (Chevy Chase) and his wife (Madolyn Smith) move to a cottage in the country, where he tries to write a novel.

title: 16 Blocks
description: A boozy, world-weary NYPD cop (Bruce Willis) must outwit rogue officers planning to kill a witness (Mos Def) who is set to testify against them.

title: Jackie Chan's First Strike
description: A CIA operative goes undercover to find a former agent selling nuclear secrets to the Russians.

title: Grilled
description: Two down-on-their-luck meat salesmen (Ray Romano, Kevin James) land in hot water when their "foolproof" scheme backfires.

title: Before Sunset
description: A novelist (Ethan Hawke) and an environmentalist (Julie Delpy) who met on a train nine years earlier reunite in Paris.

title: State and Main
description: A filmmaker (William H. Macy) copes with a predatory actor (Alec Baldwin), a demanding actress (Sarah Jessica Parker) and a major location problem as he tries to shoot a movie in small-town Vermont.

title: Disorderlies
description: A greedy heir (Anthony Geary) hires three inept, rap-singing orderlies (The Fat Boys) to care for his rich uncle (Ralph Bellamy).

title: Osmosis Jones
description: One white blood cell's race against the biological clock to hunt down and destroy a lethal new virus.

title: Club Paradise
description: A Chicago firefighter (Robin Williams) and a reggae musician (Jimmy Cliff) turn a Caribbean dive into a swinging-singles resort.

title: Cannonball Run II
description: J.J. McClure (Burt Reynolds), his mechanic (Dom DeLuise) and other veteran competitors enter another cross-country auto race.

title: Monkey Trouble
description: A 9-year-old (Thora Birch) learns her new pet monkey worked as a pickpocket for a Gypsy hustler (Harvey Keitel).

title: Driving Miss Daisy
description: An Atlanta widow (Jessica Tandy) and her chauffeur (Morgan Freeman) reflect the changing times, from 1948 to 1973.

title: Lost & Found
description: To spend time with an attractive neighbor (Sophie Marceau), a man (David Spade) kidnaps her dog, which proceeds to swallow a valuable ring.

title: Graffiti Bridge
description: The Kid (Prince) and his rock-club rival (Morris Day) disagree about music in a sequel to the 1984 film "Purple Rain."

title: Almost Heroes
description: A tracker (Chris Farley) and his entourage help a fop (Matthew Perry) try to beat Lewis & Clark to the Pacific Ocean in 1804.

title: Stroker Ace
description: NASCAR driver Stroker Ace runs into problems when a confrontation with his commercial sponsor causes him to lose his contract. Clyde Torkle, the owner of a fried-chicken chain, immediately asks Stroker to be the face of his company.

title: Night Shift
description: A meek man (Henry Winkler), his helper (Michael Keaton) and a hooker (Shelley Long) run a call-girl ring from the city morgue.

title: Presumed Innocent
description: A married prosecutor (Harrison Ford) hires an attorney (Raul Julia) to defend him against charges of murdering his seductive colleague.

title: The Killing Fields
description: Newsman Sydney Schanberg loses his friend Dith Pran in the 1975 fall of Phnom Penh.

title: The Rite
description: A veteran priest (Anthony Hopkins) introduces a skeptical seminary student (Colin O'Donoghue) to the dark side of their faith at a Vatican school where clergymen become exorcists.

title: Corrina, Corrina
description: A housekeeper (Whoopi Goldberg) brings joy to a Jewish widower (Ray Liotta) and his young daughter (Tina Majorino) in 1959 Los Angeles.

title: The Year of Living Dangerously
description: An Australian reporter (Mel Gibson) betrays his friend (Linda Hunt) and his lover (Sigourney Weaver) in volatile 1965 Indonesia.

title: Spies Like Us
description: Two clumsy bureaucrats (Chevy Chase, Dan Aykroyd) are trained as spies, then sent to Pakistan to create a diversion.

title: Suburban Commando
description: A warrior (Hulk Hogan) from another galaxy escapes to Earth and moves in with an architect (Christopher Lloyd) and his wife (Shelley Duvall).

title: 8 Seconds
description: Lane Frost is a cowboy who rises to become a professional bull-riding champion in the 1980s. Along the way, he endures injuries and the ups and downs of married life.

title: New York Minute
description: An uptight teenager (Ashley Olsen) and her laid-back twin (Mary-Kate Olsen) spend a wild day on the streets of Manhattan.

title: Singles
description: A group of young adults in a Seattle apartment building faces a series of romantic crises and catastrophes.

title: Dark City
description: A demented genius (Kiefer Sutherland), a sympathetic detective and a group of ominous beings are drawn to an amnesiac (Rufus Sewell) accused of murder.

title: Fracture
description: A hotshot prosecutor (Ryan Gosling) squares off against a cunning engineer (Anthony Hopkins) who tried to murder his wife and is now defending himself in court.

title: The Jacket
description: Cared for by a physician (Kris Kristofferson), an amnesiac Gulf War veteran (Adrien Brody) has violent flashbacks and visions of the future.

title: One Crazy Summer
description: A budding cartoonist (John Cusack) helps a singer (Demi Moore) save her family home from a land developer on the island of Nantucket.

title: Frequency
description: Thirty years after the death of his father, a police officer is stunned to find himself communicating with him thanks to an old ham radio.

title: The Majestic
description: Residents of a 1950s coastal community mistake an amnesiac screenwriter for a soldier who never returned from the war.

title: Fandango
description: A prankster (Kevin Costner), an ROTC student (Judd Nelson) and their buddies hop in a Cadillac for one last fling in 1971 Texas.

title: The Good Lie
description: An employment counselor (Reese Witherspoon) dedicates her life to helping a group of Sudanese orphans find jobs and adjust to their new lives in America.

title: Hooper
description: An upstart (Jan-Michael Vincent) pushes a veteran Hollywood stuntman (Burt Reynolds), daring him to try a new stunt.

title: Alex & Me
description: Teenager Reagan Wills dreams of playing soccer like Alex Morgan, her hero. A poster of the soccer star magically comes to life in Reagan's bedroom, and Alex helps Reagan learn the value of determination.

title: The Accidental Tourist
description: A numb travel-writer (William Hurt) takes up with his dog trainer (Geena Davis) after his son dies and his wife (Kathleen Turner) leaves.

title: Message in a Bottle
description: A woman (Robin Wright Penn) learns that the author of a romantic note that washed ashore is a shipbuilder (Kevin Costner) whose wife died young and tragically.

title: Rumble in the Bronx
description: A Hong Kong policeman (Jackie Chan) in New York defends a woman shopkeeper (Anita Mui) against bikers who want protection money.

title: Executive Decision
description: A commando squad must conduct a midair assault upon a hijacked plane loaded with terrorists and a deadly nerve gas.
